items.actClause:
AN ACT to amend the public authorities law, in relation to establishing the
North Shore water authority
items.lawCode: Add Art 5 Title 5-A §§1114-a - 1114-s, Pub Auth L
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S6491

SPONSOR: GAUGHRAN
 
TITLE OF BILL:  An act to amend the public authorities law, in
relation to establishing the North Shore water authority

 
PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

To provide authorization and statutory framework for the establishment
of a North Shore Water Authority to operate in the service area present-
ly operated by a private utility in the northwest portion of Nassau
County, servicing the residents of the Village of Sea Cliff, and
portions of the village of Old Brookville, Village of Roslyn Harbor, and
residents in the unincorporated hamlets of Glenwood Landing, Glen Head
and the City of Glen Cove.

 
SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:

Section One contains the Legislative Findings.

Section Two amends the Public Service Law by adding a new Title 5-A,
entitled the North Shore Water Authority. Title 5-A contains nineteen
sections, which establish the statutory scheme for the Water Authority.
These sections are as follows:

1114-a: Provides that the act may be cited as the "Water Authority of
North Shore Act"

1114-b:Contains pertinent definitions.

1114-c: Provides the water district boundaries.

1114-d: Establishes the public benefit corporate structure and provides
the appointment process for the board of directors, public hearing
requirements before the purchase or condemnation of property within the
service area, nonbinding referendum requirements, and weighting of the
votes cast by the board of directors. Further, this section contains the
duties of the Board and the Officers appointed thereto.

1114-e: Establishes the powers of the authority.

1114-f: Provide that public officers and employees may be transferred to
the authority upon consent of the transferring employer.

1114-g: Authorizes the authority to issue bonds.

1114-h: Specifies the remedies of bondholders in the event that the
authority defaults on a bond and provides that actions relating to
default on bonds shall be adjudicated in Nassau County.

1114-i: Provides that the state and municipalities thereof are not
liable on bonds issued by the authority.

1114-j: Governs monies of the authority.

1114-k: Provides that the bonds of the authority shall be considered
securities for investment and deposit.

1114-1: Limits alterations by the state impacting bonds.
1114-m: Exempts the authority from taxes and special levies or assess-
ments and allows for the establishment of PILOTS upon consent.

1114-n: Relates to limitations on actions against the authority.

1114-o: Governs conflicts of interest of members of the board of direc-
tors and officers and employees of the authority.

1114-p: Provides that contracts of the authority shall be let pursuant
to the Wicks Law.

1114-q: Contains a separability clause.

1114-r: Governs inconsistent provisions.

1114-t- Governs acquisition by the authority via eminent domain.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

The ratepayers in the villages of Sea Cliff, Old Brookville, Roslyn
Harbor and the hamlets of Glenwood Landing and Glen Head are currently
serviced by American Water, a private water utility.  Unfortunately, a
variety of factors has led to exorbitant water rates for some customers
and disruptions in service. This legislation would authorize, at local
option, the establishment of a North Shore Water Authority. Upon forma-
tion, the Authority would be authorized to take over the assets and
functions currently provided by the private utility.

Public water authorities have been successful in protecting, preserving
and enhancing the quality and quantity of water on Long Island. The
formation of a public water authority should be an option for the
impacted localities to consider when evaluating possible remedies to
address the issues that have arisen with the private water utility.

 
PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New Bill.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None to the State.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately.
